RESEARCH.md.inserted_paragraph: **Recorded descendants and evolved life-cycle switching, 8 October 2026.** [The new reconstruction](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/LINEAGE-CONTINUATION-INTEGRATION.md) checks 3,808 source phase/culture records, 3,600 parent links and 174 terminal paths. In a directly matched mutation-reversion assay, evolved and reverted genotypes complete 42/72 versus 7/72 cycles; all 44 viable endpoints of the relevant evolutionary treatment trace through the focal ancestor. Six new Lean theorems/six audits verify joint-count and conditional-stage arithmetic. This now supplies a scoped empirical inherited-change-to-continuation connection; a separate marginal-product discrepancy does not erase the focal genetic result. Missing records, a single mutation origin, supplied support and conventional explanatory credit remain. **Next:** source-matched prediction under the actual replacement rule, with held-out validation and an adequately informed lineage comparator. / **实际后继：** 联合记录与回复实验得到信用，完整目标仍开放；不把本细菌实验并入既有酵母几何历史。

theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-exis.inserted_paragraph: **Inherited switching → realized cycle continuation, 8 October 2026.** [The recorded-lineage study](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/LINEAGE-CONTINUATION-INTEGRATION.md) adds a directly linked bacterial assay and multigenerational parent records: 42/72 completed cycles versus 7/72 after focal mutation reversion, with six checked Lean results for joint and conditional-stage accounting. This establishes an empirical connection at its experimental scope and constrains how separate conditions jointly realize continuation. Formation of wider support, full evolutionary recovery and superior prediction remain open; the conventional developmental/lineage explanation is credited.

**遗传改变与实际后继 / Inherited change and observed continuation, 8 October 2026.** [谱系与生命周期重构](../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/LINEAGE-CONTINUATION-INTEGRATION.md)核查3,808项阶段记录与3,600条亲代联系，同日回复实验逐管接续得到42／72与7／72完成。新增6项 Lean 定理／6项审计，保留共同完成与边际相乘的差别。 / The measured connection is now credited at its experimental scope; inherited switching, source-reported genetic causality and actual cycle completion remain distinguished from broader superiority and supplied support renewal.

sources/SOURCES.md.inserted_paragraph: **Recorded bacterial lineages and genetic reversion, 8 October 2026.** [Doulcier et al. 2025](evolutionary-selection/doulcier-2025/README.md) preserves original article XML, cited Zenodo metadata and the complete code/data ZIP, whose MD5 matches the deposited checksum. Two workbooks supply genealogy and life-cycle assays; selected author notebooks were read but not executed. Our linked-record reconstruction does not claim genomic alignment or Bayesian inference replication.
